description: Flat patient-/session-level metadata schema for a clinical registry of breast cancer radiotherapy, capturing demographics, tumor and biomarker characteristics, prior treatments, radiotherapy planning, treatment-session deviations and acute toxicities, and follow-up outcomes such as recurrence and recovery.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the registry record or row. Use a stable anonymized code, not a direct patient identifier.

patient_id.descr: Anonymized unique patient identifier linking multiple sessions and follow-up records for the same individual.

session_id.descr: Unique identifier for the radiotherapy session or fraction record. Use a stable code if one patient has multiple treatment sessions.

patient_age_years.descr: Age at registry entry or at radiotherapy start, in years.

sex.descr: Biological sex or sex assigned at birth. Common values: female, male, intersex, unknown.

ethnicity.descr: Self-reported ethnicity or ethnicity category used by the registry, if collected.

race.descr: Race category used by the registry, if collected. Use controlled vocabulary where possible.

height_cm.descr: Patient height at baseline, in centimeters.

weight_kg.descr: Patient weight at baseline, in kilograms.

body_mass_index.descr: Calculated body mass index at baseline, in kg/m^2.

menopausal_status.descr: Menopausal status at baseline. Common values: premenopausal, perimenopausal, postmenopausal, unknown.

performance_status.descr: Functional status at baseline, for example ECOG or Karnofsky score depending on registry convention.

smoking_status.descr: Smoking status at baseline. Common values: never, former, current, unknown.

alcohol_use_status.descr: Alcohol use category at baseline, if collected.

comorbidity_index.descr: Quantified comorbidity burden at baseline, for example Charlson Comorbidity Index score.

prior_breast_cancer_history.descr: Indicates whether the patient has a prior history of breast cancer before the index diagnosis.

family_history_breast_cancer.descr: Indicates whether there is a family history of breast cancer.

genetic_marker_name.descr: Name of the genetic marker, mutation, or biomarker being recorded, for example BRCA1, BRCA2, HER2, ER/PR, PIK3CA.

genetic_marker_result.descr: Result for the specified genetic marker. Common values may include positive, negative, amplified, mutated, wildtype, equivocal, unknown.

genetic_marker_method.descr: Laboratory method used to assess the genetic marker, for example PCR, sequencing, IHC, FISH.

tumor_laterality.descr: Side of the affected breast. Common values: left, right, bilateral, unknown.

tumor_histology.descr: Histologic subtype of the breast cancer, for example invasive ductal carcinoma, invasive lobular carcinoma, DCIS.

tumor_grade.descr: Tumor grade according to the local or reported grading system, for example 1, 2, 3, or G1-G3.

tumor_stage_clinical.descr: Clinical stage at diagnosis using the registry's staging convention, for example TNM or AJCC stage.

tumor_stage_pathologic.descr: Pathologic stage after surgery, if available, using the registry's staging convention.

node_status.descr: Regional lymph node involvement status at diagnosis or pathology assessment.

metastatic_status.descr: Presence or absence of distant metastatic disease at the relevant clinical time point.

biomarker_er_status.descr: Estrogen receptor status. Common values: positive, negative, equivocal, unknown.

biomarker_pr_status.descr: Progesterone receptor status. Common values: positive, negative, equivocal, unknown.

biomarker_her2_status.descr: HER2 status. Common values: positive, negative, equivocal, amplified, unknown.

ki67_percent.descr: Ki-67 proliferation index as a percentage, if measured.

previous_surgery_type.descr: Type of prior breast surgery before radiotherapy, for example lumpectomy, mastectomy, reconstruction, none.

previous_surgery_date.descr: Date of the most recent relevant surgery before radiotherapy.

previous_chemotherapy.descr: Indicates whether the patient received chemotherapy before radiotherapy.

previous_chemotherapy_regimen.descr: Name or description of the prior chemotherapy regimen, if applicable.

previous_chemotherapy_end_date.descr: Date the prior chemotherapy course ended, if applicable.

previous_hormone_therapy.descr: Indicates whether the patient received endocrine or hormone therapy before radiotherapy.

previous_hormone_therapy_agent.descr: Name of the prior hormone therapy agent, if applicable.

previous_targeted_therapy.descr: Indicates whether the patient received targeted therapy before radiotherapy.

previous_targeted_therapy_agent.descr: Name of the prior targeted therapy agent, if applicable.

prior_radiotherapy.descr: Indicates whether the patient had any prior radiotherapy before the index course.

prior_radiotherapy_site.descr: Anatomic site of any prior radiotherapy, if applicable.

radiotherapy_intent.descr: Treatment intent of the radiotherapy course. Common values: adjuvant, neoadjuvant, curative, palliative, prophylactic.

radiotherapy_technique.descr: Radiotherapy delivery technique, for example 3D-CRT, IMRT, VMAT, proton therapy, brachytherapy.

radiation_type.descr: Type of radiation used, for example photon, electron, proton, mixed.

target_volume.descr: Radiotherapy target volume, for example whole breast, chest wall, regional nodes, boost volume.

laterality_treated.descr: Laterality of the treated field. Common values: left, right, bilateral.

end_date_radiotherapy.descr: Date the radiotherapy course ended or was completed.

planned_total_dose_gy.descr: Planned total prescribed dose for the course, in Gray (Gy).

delivered_total_dose_gy.descr: Total dose actually delivered, in Gray (Gy).

planned_fraction_count.descr: Number of planned fractions/sessions in the radiotherapy course.

dose_per_fraction_gy.descr: Planned or delivered dose per fraction, in Gray (Gy).

treatment_duration_days.descr: Total treatment duration in days from first to last session.

boost_given.descr: Indicates whether a boost dose was administered.

boost_total_dose_gy.descr: Total boost dose delivered, in Gray (Gy), if applicable.

planning_target_volume_cc.descr: Planning target volume size, in cubic centimeters, if recorded.

organ_at_risk_constraint_met.descr: Indicates whether organ-at-risk dose constraints were met for the course.

treatment_session_date.descr: Date of the individual treatment session or fraction.

session_number.descr: Sequential number of the treatment session within the course, starting at 1.

planned_session_dose_gy.descr: Planned dose for the session, in Gray (Gy).

delivered_session_dose_gy.descr: Actual dose delivered during the session, in Gray (Gy).

session_deviation_flag.descr: Indicates whether this session deviated from the planned protocol.

session_deviation_type.descr: Type of deviation from protocol, for example missed fraction, dose reduction, setup issue, interruption, machine downtime.

session_deviation_description.descr: Free-text description of the deviation, if any.

session_interruption_minutes.descr: Duration of any interruption or delay during the session, in minutes.

acute_side_effect_present.descr: Indicates whether any acute side effects were observed during or immediately after the session.

acute_side_effect_type.descr: Type of acute side effect, for example dermatitis, fatigue, nausea, pain, edema.

acute_side_effect_grade.descr: Severity grade of the acute side effect, for example CTCAE grade 1-5.

acute_side_effect_onset_date.descr: Date the acute side effect first appeared, if known.

acute_side_effect_resolution_date.descr: Date the acute side effect resolved, if known.

treatment_completion_status.descr: Overall status of the radiotherapy course. Common values: completed, interrupted, discontinued, switched, unknown.

reason_for_noncompletion.descr: Reason the radiotherapy course was not completed as planned, if applicable.

follow_up_date.descr: Date of follow-up assessment used for outcome capture.

recurrence_flag.descr: Indicates whether disease recurrence occurred by the follow-up date.

recurrence_date.descr: Date of first documented recurrence, if applicable.

recurrence_site.descr: Site of recurrence, for example local breast, regional node, distant metastasis, contralateral breast.

disease_free_survival_months.descr: Disease-free survival time from index date to recurrence or censoring, in months.

overall_survival_months.descr: Overall survival time from index date to death or censoring, in months.

patient_status_at_followup.descr: Vital status or clinical status at follow-up, for example alive without disease, alive with disease, deceased, lost to follow-up.

recovery_status.descr: Clinical recovery status after treatment, for example fully recovered, partially recovered, not recovered, unknown.

recovery_time_days.descr: Time from end of radiotherapy to documented recovery, in days, if applicable.

secondary_malignancy_flag.descr: Indicates whether a secondary malignancy was diagnosed during follow-up.

data_source_registry_center.descr: Name or code of the registry site or clinical center contributing the record.

record_last_updated.descr: Date when the record was last updated in the registry.
